docs/ESP32_S3_SERIAL_PORT_RESET.md:17:This is expected on ESP32-family boards that use the USB-UART modem-control lines for automatic reset/bootloader entry. Espressif documents that `DTR` and `RTS` from USB-UART bridges such as FTDI, CP210x, or CH340x are connected through the auto-reset circuit to `GPIO0` and `EN` (`CHIP_PU`), and that some operating systems, drivers, or serial terminal programs may change those modem-control lines when opening the serial port.
docs/ESP32_S3_SERIAL_PORT_RESET.md:60:The same class of startup reset was also observed when Python configured `DTR=False` and `RTS=False` before opening the port. Therefore, on this exact board/adapter/driver path, pre-setting the modem-control values in pyserial is not sufficient evidence that opening the port will be reset-free.
